{"description":"This adds a design-phase reading to closure_report beside today's build reading:
- traceability over allocation plus planned checks;
- budgets that read `basis`;
- parking honoured.
Every reading names its phase. Planned by the 2026-09-29 fix program.

HOW IT IS BUILT (R-I, branch fix/closure-reads-a-design-phase, 2026-09-29). Option (c) of dec:idea-closure-has-a-design-phase-reading-and-a-build-phase-reading: TWO READINGS, ALWAYS BOTH, AGAINST THE ONE DECLARED CRITERION.
- The top level of closure_report stays the BUILD reading, unchanged in meaning, now labelled `phase: build`.
  - Traceability is the delivery line.
  - A budget ALSO needs every numbered contribution `measured`, which it never checked before.
- A new `design` reading carries `phase: design`.
  - A requirement is traced when a capability satisfying it (not discontinued) is ALLOCATED to a part and has a check PLANNED, of any status, on the capability or the requirement. Decomposition rolls up as the delivery line does.
  - A budget closes on an estimate that carries its basis. An unstated basis reads as `estimated`, as budget_report reads it.
  - Its note says it tells nothing about whether anything is built.
- Every leg carries `phase`, and every note starts "BUILD phase" or "DESIGN phase".
- release_report's closure summary carries `design_verdict` beside the build verdict.
- PARKING, in both phases: a requirement with a `parks` ruling on an ACCEPTED decision (the shared is_parked predicate) leaves the population and is counted in the leg's `parked` field, never as the first hole. A proposed ruling parks nothing.

WHY THE OTHER OPTIONS LOST.
- (a) A declared `closure_phase` knob shows ONE answer, so a design-phase "closes" would stand alone and be quotable as "done", the counter-argument the requirement itself keeps.
- (b) A basis per leg adds five knobs and makes combinations nobody asked for sayable.
- (d) Letting a passing analysis check close traceability weakens what "passing" means, which is the unevidenced claim the provenance leg exists to catch.
- (e) A separate design-completeness report splits the answer the owner asked closure to give.
(c) shows both answers at once from one criterion and needs no new declaration. The idea decision is NOT settled by this. It stays the owner's.","name":"closure_report reads a design phase (allocated and traced, checks planned, budgets closing on based estimates, parked items parked) and a build phase (delivered, checked, measured), and names which it reports","provenance":"authored","status":"planned"}
